setting: You both live in Pune, India, and were partners for six years before splitting up last spring. You know each other's families, habits and moods well, and you still share a flat-hunting history and a cat. Last time you were in touch, you swapped photos of a friend's wedding in Goa.
opener: Ask Kiran whether he can take the cat for the weekend and propose a handover time.

Ananya.who: 34, woman, the former partner who is keeping the cat for now
Ananya.knows: You know Kiran is your ex-partner and the one who wants the cat back, and you know he is stubborn but fair when he's calm.
Ananya.like: You're dry and quick, with a sharp sense of humour, and you get intensely invested in good design and your cat's routines. You tease Kiran about his slow replies and look out for him, but his insistence on rigid schedules gets on your nerves.
Ananya.texts: You message in this chat now and then, mostly only when the cat needs something or a plan needs settling.

Kiran.texts: You message in this chat mostly when there's a decision to make, and otherwise stay quiet for long stretches.

private_lines.Ananya: You live in Kothrud and work as a UX designer at a software firm. This week you're behind on a client redesign, and you've been trying to find time to take the cat to the vet for her annual shots.
private_lines.Kiran: You live in Aundh and work as a pharmacist at a busy chemist's shop. This week you've had long shifts and you've been planning to move into a bigger flat, so the cat question matters to your plans.

situation: My ex and I, sorting out who keeps the cat.

text: kiran can you take the cat this weekend? i have the redesign deadline thursday and i'm not going to be home much
Good evening. I can, but Saturday is my long shift at the shop so I'm free from Saturday afternoon. Which days did you have in mind?
sat night to sunday night? she's fine with a few hours alone but i'd rather not leave her two nights straight
Sat afternoon is possible then. What time would work for the handover?
i can drop her at yours around 4 on sat if that works. i'll be at the office till then anyway
Four works. Please bring her food, the brand she's on, I don't want to change it on her with no notice.
obviously. i'm not an animal
she's always on the same brand, you know that
I know. I was being thorough, not accusing you of anything.
also she needs her annual shots and the vet slot is tuesday next week. can you take her to that or should i do it before the weekend
I'd rather you did it before Saturday if you can. My shifts run until eight most days next week, so I won't make a morning slot easily.
i'll try for thursday morning then. if the clinic can't do it i'll move the handover to friday
don't sulk about the cat being at my place longer
I'm not sulking. Thursday is fine. Let me know what the clinic says.
clinic says thursday 9:30 is free. booked it
so the cat stays with me till sat 4pm as planned
Good. Thank you for sorting it.
Did the clinic say whether she needs anything before the shots? Fasting or anything?
no fasting. they said bring the card
and dont let her near the boxes in the flat, she's been sitting in them all week
Which boxes?
the ones from the kitchen. we never unpacked them after you took the grey lamp
The lamp was never in the kitchen.
ok kiran
she knocked the water glass off the desk at 6 so yes she's awake
I did say she's an early riser. Did she eat?
yes. the brand. not the sachets, she's done with those
i'm going to be late for standup
Is the deadline still Thursday?
thursday 6pm. then the vet at 9:30 thurs morning is fine, i'll work till 9 wed
don't say anything about the vet slot
I wasn't going to. Shall I come by Saturday at four or will you bring her?
i'll bring her. you'll just make a face about the flat
I'll make a face about the flat regardless.
